nodes.name: Hydrothermal NiMn-LDH growth
nodes.procedure: NiMn-LDH nanosheets were grown on a NF substrate by hydrothermal synthesis at 90 °C for 12 h.

unit_operations.name: Hydrothermal synthesis
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: NiMn-LDH nanosheets were grown on a NF substrate by hydrothermal synthesis at 90 °C for 12 h.

nodes.source_text: Initially, NiMn-LDH nanosheets were grown on a NF substrate by hydrothermal synthesis at 90 °C for 12 h.

nodes.name: Infrared photoreduction decoration
nodes.procedure: The NF-supported NiMn-LDH was immersed in 10 mL of aqueous RhCl₃ solution (optimized at 4 mg/mL concentration) and irradiated with a 250 W infrared lamp for 2 h, facilitating the hydrolytic deposition of Rh³⁺ to form the a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH heterostructure.

unit_operations.name: Impregnation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: the NF-supported NiMn-LDH was immersed in 10 mL of aqueous RhCl₃ solution

unit_operations.name: Photoreduction
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: irradiated with a 250 W infrared lamp for 2 h, facilitating the hydrolytic deposition of Rh³⁺

nodes.source_text: Subsequently, the NF-supported NiMn-LDH was immersed in 10 mL of aqueous RhCl₃ solution and irradiated with a 250 W infrared lamp for 2 h, facilitating the hydrolytic deposition of Rh³⁺ to form the a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH heterostructure (Fig. 1a). To optimize Rh species loading... the sample prepared with 4 mg/mL RhCl₃ (designated as a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH-4)

nodes.description: OER performance in 1.0 M KOH (three-electrode setup)
nodes.source_text: OER polarization curves (Figs. 3a and S17) reveal that the a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH heterostructure outperforms all control samples... needing merely an overpotential of 249 mV to reach a current density of 10 mA cm⁻²... at a high current density of 500 mA cm⁻² in 1.0 M KOH electrolyte, the overpotentials for OER... are 378 mV... Tafel slope analysis... achieves an ultralow Tafel slope of 22.3 mV dec⁻¹... Cdl... reaches 11.6 mF cm⁻².

nodes.description: HER performance in 1.0 M KOH (three-electrode setup)
nodes.source_text: The HER polarization curves (Figs. 3d and S26) demonstrate that a-Rh(OH)3/NiMn-LDH exhibits the higher HER activity... requiring only a 25 mV overpotential to achieve a current density of 10 mA cm⁻²... at a high current density of 500 mA cm⁻² in 1.0 M KOH electrolyte, the overpotentials for... HER are 245 mV... Tafel slope analysis... has a slope of 32.7 mV dec⁻¹... Cdl values... increasing to 8.72 mF cm⁻².

nodes.description: Overall water splitting stability in 1.0 M KOH two-electrode cell at 500 mA/cm²
nodes.source_text: the electrolyzer... maintained continuous operation for 1000 h under an industrially relevant current density of 500 mA cm⁻². The two-electrode OWS cell exhibited exceptional operational stability. It demonstrated a minimal voltage increase from an initial 1.816 V to only 1.867 V after 1000 h of continuous operation, corresponding to a negligible total increment of 51 mV.

nodes.description: OWS stability in 6.0 M KOH at industrial current density
nodes.source_text: to evaluate robustness under industrially relevant harsh conditions, we conducted a stability test in 6.0 M KOH at a high current density of 500 mA cm⁻² for ~100 h. The cell showed negligible performance degradation, with activity loss remaining below 5%.

nodes.description: OER/HER chronopotentiometry stability at 500 mA/cm² in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: durability tests under industrially relevant current densities (Fig. 3g) reveal that the catalyst maintains stable performance for 120 h at 0.5 A cm⁻² under both OER and HER without noticeable decay.

nodes.description: OWS stability in 6.0 M KOH at industrial current density
nodes.source_text: we conducted a stability test in 6.0 M KOH at a high current density of 500 mA cm⁻² for ~100 h. The cell showed negligible performance degradation, with activity loss remaining below 5% (Fig. S38).

nodes.characterization_summary: Pristine NiMn-LDH shows sharp peaks at 2θ = 11.4°, 22.7°, 34.4° for (003), (006), (012) planes. a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH shows reduced peak intensity and increased FWHM indicating amorphous a-Rh(OH)₃ coverage; Rietveld refinement confirms 91.2 wt% amorphous Rh(OH)₃ and 8.8 wt% crystalline Rh₂O₃.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To verify the structural modulation of NiMn-LDH induced by a-Rh(OH)₃, X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis was performed (Fig. 1b). ... The results confirm that the sample is composed predominantly of crystalline NiMn-LDH, accompanied by a minor crystalline Rh₂O₃ phase.

nodes.characterization_summary: Pristine NiMn-LDH shows vertically aligned ordered nanosheet array. a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH retains morphology with slight surface roughening due to uniform amorphous a-Rh(OH)₃ deposition.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) was used to investigate morphological characteristics... After loading a-Rh(OH)₃, the overall morphology of the nanosheet array remained intact, with no aggregation, collapse, or secondary crystallization observed.

properties.description: High-resolution image showing nanostructured material with irregular, wrinkled, sheet-like morphology and nanoscale features
High-magnification SEM image showing porous nanostructure with interconnected pores and sheet-like features

nodes.characterization_summary: a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH shows thicker nanosheet edges confirming uniform amorphous a-Rh(OH)₃ coating; no Rh-based nanoparticles detected.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) was employed to characterize the microstructure of a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH (Fig. 1e, f). TEM images revealed that after the loading of a-Rh(OH)₃, the edges of the LDH nanosheets became significantly thicker.

properties.description: High-resolution image showing thin, irregular sheet-like nanostructures with jagged edges and layered morphology

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMn-LDH shows lattice fringes d=0.217 nm (015). a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH shows LDH fringes 0.25 nm (018), 0.22 nm (015) and disordered atomic arrangement in a-Rh(OH)₃ regions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM)... For a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH (Fig. 1g), LDH lattice fringes (0.25 nm for (018) and 0.22 nm for (015)) were still visible.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMn-LDH shows distinct diffraction rings for (101), (110). a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH shows diffused rings confirming amorphous nature of a-Rh(OH)₃.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SAED pattern of a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH (Fig. 1h) showed diffused rings (instead of sharp spots or rings), further confirming the amorphous nature of a-Rh(OH)₃.

nodes.characterization_summary: Uniform distribution of Ni, Mn, O, Rh at single-nanosheet scale in a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH with no Rh aggregation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy mapping (EDS-mapping) was used... For a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH, Ni, Mn, Rh, and O were uniformly distributed at the single-nanosheet scale, with no Rh aggregation or phase separation.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p in NiMn-LDH at 873.62 eV (2p1/2), 855.82 eV (2p3/2); shifts to 874.10 eV, 856.28 eV (+0.48 eV, +0.46 eV) in a-Rh(OH)3/NiMn-LDH indicating increased Ni oxidation state from interfacial charge transfer. Ni d-band center shifts from -5.19 eV to -4.80 eV. Rh 3d5/2 at 309.6 eV, 3d3/2 at 314.3 eV characteristic of Rh3+ in amorphous Rh(OH)3.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni 2p spectra (Fig. 2a) exhibited marked changes upon a-Rh(OH)3 deposition: for pristine NiMn-LDH, the Ni 2p1/2 and Ni 2p3/2 peaks appeared at 873.62 eV and 855.82 eV, respectively. In the a-Rh(OH)3/NiMn-LDH heterostructure, these peaks underwent positive shifts of 0.48 eV (to 874.10 eV) and 0.46 eV (to 856.28 eV)... X-ray photoelectron valence-band spectra (Fig. 2b) reveal that the Ni d-band center shifts from -5.19 eV in pristine NiMn-LDH to -4.80 eV in a-Rh(OH)3/NiMn-LDH... The Rh 3d spectrum (Fig. S11) features a doublet at 309.6 eV (Rh 3d5/2) and 314.3 eV (Rh 3d3/2), characteristic of Rh3+ species in amorphous Rh(OH)3.

nodes.characterization_summary: Both samples show g=2.251 signal; a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH has higher intensity indicating more paramagnetic Ni centers. Strengthened g=2.003 signal indicates oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EPR spectroscopy was employed... the a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH composite exhibits a markedly higher EPR signal intensity... The EPR spectra show a strengthened signal at g = 2.003, which is characteristic of electrons localized in oxygen vacancies.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge shifts to higher energy in a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH indicating increased Ni oxidation state.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni K-edge XANES and EXAFS analyses... This is evidenced by a subtle shift of the Ni K-edge to higher energy in the XANES spectra (Fig. 2c), indicating an increased average oxidation state of Ni.

properties.technique: Ni K-edge X-ray Absorption Near Edge Structure

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMn-LDH: Ni-O CN=5.8, Ni-Ni CN=2.9±0.2. a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH: Ni-O CN=6.5, Ni-Ni CN=8.8±0.3, Ni-Rh path R=3.49-3.50 Å CN~1.0. Rh-O CN=5.6±0.3, R=2.02 Å; weak Rh-Rh CN≈0.7, R=3.08 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Quantitative EXAFS fitting... the fitting consistently identifies a direct Ni–Rh scattering path at R = 3.49–3.50 Å with a coordination number (CN) of ~1.0... Rh K-edge EXAFS analyses... yielded a Rh–O first-shell CN of 5.6±0.3 with a bond length of 2.02 Å.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman during OER: NiMn-LDH shows NiOOH peaks at 460 cm⁻¹, 550 cm⁻¹ at ~1.50 V vs RHE. a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH shows peaks at ~1.30 V (200 mV lower potential).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 5a and b present the in situ Raman spectral evolution... these NiOOH peaks appear in a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH at a much lower potential (~1.30 V), representing a ~200 mV positive shift in Ni oxidation onset.

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance Cdl = 11.6 mF cm⁻² for a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH (vs 2.7 mF cm⁻² for NiMn-LDH) indicating increased electrochemically active surface area.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The electrochemically active surface area (ECSA) was estimated from the double-layer capacitance (Cdl) obtained via non-Faradaic CV scans (Figs. 3c, S20, S21). Pristine NiMn-LDH exhibits a Cdl of 2.7 mF cm⁻², whereas a-Rh(OH)3/NiMn-LDH reaches 11.6 mF cm⁻².

nodes.characterization_summary: a-Rh(OH)₃/NiMn-LDH shows smallest charge-transfer resistance Rct indicating efficient interfacial charge transfer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) analysis (Figs. S24, S25) further supports these findings. Nyquist plots show that a-Rh(OH)3/NiMn-LDH has the smallest charge-transfer resistance (Rct).
